cells.cell: artifact_review_gate x site_widget x pending / decided
cells.driven: one real widget-started run (096e5a56-d42b-46fc-9dd4-8e3da018998b) produced its artifact and its review gate went PENDING (53781825-e912-4aaa-8275-4337f90efe85, created 06:39:00.345Z)
cells.codeFact: packages/agents/src/agentic-run-panel.tsx:1620 `const widgetHostedPanel = ambientLifecycleHost === "site_widget";` gates BOTH readings of the review slot: `:1625` `status === "completed" && !widgetHostedPanel ? reviewSlot.ref : null` and `:1633` `(reviewMayStillOpen && !widgetHostedPanel)`. So on this host the panel neither draws the gate in place nor draws the placeholder. And the injected part is withheld for the same turn: src/lib/lifecycle/lifecycle-run-outbox.ts `injectionForTurn` returns null when `part.viewType === RUN_CARD_CARRIED_VIEW_TYPE && turnCarriesRunCardFor(content, entry.runId)` — one review card per gate per turn (cinatra#2997), on the ground that the run card already shows the gate. The two rules meet on `site_widget`: the injection is suppressed because the run card would show it, and the run card is told not to show it.
cells.verdict: UNREACHABLE on this head. Not a limit of this round's driving.

cells.driven: two sentences typed into the widget's own composer on two fresh conversations: 'Run the agent @cinatra-ai/blog-draft-writer-agent every weekday at 9 in the morning.' and the same with 'Europe/Berlin time.' added, after the first was answered with a question about the timezone
cells.codeFact: `Not available to you.` is `schedule_proposal_render`'s own fixed refusal, returned when `resolveProposer()` yields null (src/lib/lifecycle/schedule-proposal-mcp.ts). The primitive IS in the widget allowlist (packages/mcp-server/src/delegated-widget-tool-policy.ts lists `schedule_proposal_render`), and the other two conditions of `resolveProposer` — `ctx.userId` and `ctx.orgId` under a `public_site_widget` delegation — were satisfied by the SAME widget session minutes earlier, because `readFramePerson()` in src/lib/lifecycle/named-agent-start-mcp.ts:227-236 reads exactly that triple and admitted this session's run start. By elimination the failing condition is `delegated.lifecycleRead !== true` at schedule-proposal-mcp.ts:161-163.
cells.verdict: UNREACHABLE on this head, with the refusal measured in the widget's own conversation.
